prompts.ug: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape school-selection card illustration for AdBox. Create a fun premium 3D clay-render miniature of University of Ghana, Legon: charming cream-white university buildings with terracotta red pitched roofs, a central square clock tower, lush rounded tropical trees and a winding campus path on a soft rounded miniature island. Playful inflated proportions, smooth matte clay and soft plastic materials, tasteful tiny floating graduation cap and books, warm cheerful daylight, soft ambient occlusion and beautiful shadows. Pale lavender seamless background, rich but harmonious accents. Isometric three-quarter camera, centered readable main building, generous clear margins, all important features contained in the central 65 percent so it crops gracefully into both a wide card and a square thumbnail. Wide 3:2 landscape composition. Polished whimsical collectible toy diorama, entertaining and welcoming, clearly an illustration inspired by the school rather than a factual architectural model. No text, letters, logos, watermark, UI, frame, or photorealism. This is asset 1 of a consistent five-school series.
